source: Curated ComicsBox USA team series and first Italian publication mappings
rules: Every team series is explicitly pinned by ComicsBox code and title in this versioned manifest.
Core runs, annuals and team-led specials are followed issue by issue; unrelated guest appearances are excluded.
The X-Force path includes New Mutants 98-100 as the documented transition into the team.
A physical Italian issue keeps its global ownership identity; reading progress remains path-local through readingStep.contentIds.
Alternate continuations, Age of Apocalypse, cross-company stories and reprint-only USA series are excluded.
Missing Italian first publications remain explicit audit gaps and are never replaced with invented editions.
